items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had a trumpet part – a trumpet book to do, and I just chose to use my flugelhorn mostly for solos

ctx.x: How did he use the flugelhorn? Was that – talk about how the flugelhorn was played within that.
He didn’t particularly condone it. He just had – I had a trumpet part – a trumpet book to do, and I just chose to use my flugelhorn mostly for solos, rather than play . . .
